long_biography.plain_text:
Timothy Alan Hale built Coastal Cloud around a Florida-based, onshore consulting team for organisations adopting Salesforce. He and fellow founder Sara Hale wanted an alternative to the travel-heavy routines they had known in large consultancies. Their model paired remote collaboration with local offices, allowing the firm to compete for clients far beyond Palm Coast.

Hale helped design the firm's domestic delivery method and promoted work experience for local students as it expanded. The founders partnered with Sverica Capital and Salesforce Ventures to develop the company. Hale later delegated daily leadership to Eric Berridge, an experienced Salesforce-services entrepreneur. Tata Consultancy Services acquired Coastal in 2026, folding the Florida-founded practice into its global technology-services network.
